description: Adds a page the way the Pages panel does, on a Xodia template site: a page file that mirrors its folders (src/pages/services/web/Design.tsx) and its route in src/routes.tsx at /<parent>/<slug>, inside the site's layout, with a starter section (data-section="page-header": the title tag, the h1 and a line to replace). parent is the folder it goes in; folderPage true makes the page at that folder's own address, with its file inside the folder (src/pages/what-we-do/WhatWeDo.tsx) and a starter list of links to the folder's pages to edit. Addresses are lowercase words with dashes, up to 5 folder levels; an address another page, folder or collection uses is refused with address_clash and the reason (a collection's item level, /blog/<slug>, belongs to its items unless the collection reserves that slug). Refused with plan_limit past the plan's page limit, and with add_unsupported on sites whose pages are set up in code (add the route by hand there, skill create-page). Never write the route or page file yourself on a template site. A page per collection item is never a page: create_collection makes the collection page. Writes unsaved changes the user reviews and saves in Xodia, and the site plan follows in the same change.

branch.description: Optional branch; default the branch the workspace has open

folderPage.description: true: the page at the parent folder's own address (/services), its folder page. slug is ignored

parent.description: The folder the page goes in ("services" or "services/web", up to 5 levels); omit for the site root. Missing folders are made by the address

slug.description: Optional: the last part of the address (lowercase, dashes); default from the title

title.description: The page's name: its h1, its title tag and its label in the Pages panel

name: create_page
title: Create a page
